lines.text: A prayer of Moses the man of God.
Lord, You have been our dwelling place
or You brought forth the earth and the world,
For in Your sight a thousand years
are but a day that passes,
or a watch of the night.
You sweep them away in their sleep;
they are like the new grass of the morning—
in the morning it springs up new,
but by evening it fades and withers.

pictures.scene: John Constable, The Hay Wain — the old cottage standing under its great tree beside the river where the same family has lived and worked for years, a prayer of Moses the man of God, Lord, You have been our dwelling place
pictures.name: pd_constable_woning

pictures.scene: Caspar Wolf, Lauteraar — the bare rock ledge over the glacier with two small figures standing on it under mountains older than any of them, through all generations, before the mountains were born
pictures.name: pd_wolf_bergen

pictures.scene: Isaac Levitan, Above Eternal Peace — the little wooden chapel on its headland under an enormous sky of moving cloud and water, or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting
pictures.name: pd_levitan_eeuwig

pictures.scene: Gustave Courbet, A Burial at Ornans — the crucifix raised over the open grave with the priest and the acolytes standing round it, You are God, You return man to dust
pictures.name: pd_courbet_stof

pictures.scene: Hubert Robert, Washerwomen in the Ruins of the Colosseum — women and children at their small fire under a vault that took an empire to build and has outlived it, return, O sons of mortals, for in Your sight a thousand years
pictures.name: pd_robert_duizend

pictures.scene: Joseph Wright of Derby, A Lake by Moonlight — the full moon laying its road across still water with one man walking the bank in the dark, are but a day that passes, or a watch of the night
pictures.name: pd_wright_nachtwake

pictures.scene: Ivan Shishkin, Midday near Moscow — the enormous sky standing over the ripe grain with the rutted road running away toward a far church, You sweep them away in their sleep, they are like the new grass of the morning
pictures.name: pd_shishkin_gras

pictures.scene: Ambrosius Bosschaert the Elder, Flower Still Life — the basket heaped with flowers at their fullest and one cut rose already lying spent on the stone ledge beside it, in the morning it springs up new, but by evening it fades and withers
pictures.name: pd_bosschaert_verwelkt
